_meta.description: Public corrections log. Every figure that has been published on this site and later found to be wrong is recorded here, with what was published, what it was corrected to, and the source that settled it. This file is the public view of the verified-facts ledger; entries are added by hand after the correction has been made at source, never generated.

fields.surface: where the wrong figure appeared, e.g. /doge, a card, a press line
fields.description: one plain sentence saying what was wrong
fields.source: the primary source URL that settles it
